summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VI, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing a Business Combination Agreement with Quantum Space, LLC. The deal values the combined entity at a pro forma enterprise value of approximately $1.2 billion, structured as an Up-C. Inflection Point will domesticate to a Delaware corporation, and post-closing PubCo will rename to Quantum Space, Inc. The boards of both parties approved the transaction. Closing is expected in Q4 2026, subject to shareholder and equityholder approvals. This is a de-SPAC merger, with the SPAC as the acquiring shell. The key risk-arb angle is the potential for shareholder redemptions and the timeline to regulatory clearance. No price per share, premium, or break fee were disclosed.
